description: Reference CPU capacity of each Google ClusterData2019 cell: the sum over machines of each machine's largest reported capacity.cpus in machine_events (normalized units, largest machine = 1.0), counting machines that report both a CPU and a memory capacity. All cells draw on the same per-machine values (0.259, 0.387, 0.5, 0.592, 0.709, 0.959, 1.0), so sums are comparable across cells. Cells a-d form the training fleet and e-h the test fleet; every site is sized relative to cell c.
query: SELECT machine_id, MAX(capacity.cpus) AS cpu_capacity, MAX(capacity.memory) AS memory_capacity FROM clusterdata_2019_<cell>.machine_events GROUP BY 1 HAVING cpu_capacity IS NOT NULL AND memory_capacity IS NOT NULL
source: data/machines/machines_{a..d}.csv in clusterdata2019_full.zip (extract_clusterdata2019_full.ipynb) and data/machines/machines_{e..h}.csv in cells_eh.zip (extract_cells_eh.ipynb, 2026-06-12); extract_cells.ipynb reproduces all eight with the same query
